title: Air Pollution and the Risk of Cardiac Defects: A Population-Based Case-Control Study.
authors: Hwang BF, Lee YL, Jaakkola JJ.
quote: Air Pollution and the Risk of Patent Ductus Arteriosus The risk of PDA was related to 10 ppb O3 changes in first 3 months gestation (adjusted OR = 1.19, 95% CI: 1.01-1.40) for all births, but not for term births (adjusted OR = 1.04, 95% CI: 0.85-1.28) in the single-pollutant model (Tables 3 and 5).
